description: This file contains the implementation of the LocalStorageService class, which is the default implementation of the StorageService interface for handling file storage in a local file system within the OpenMRS project. It provides methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and listing data and metadata stored locally.

classes.name: LocalStorageService
classes.description: A service class that handles local file system storage operations such as saving, retrieving, and deleting files, extending BaseStorageService and implementing StorageService.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns an InputStream for the data associated with the given key.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata such as size, MIME type, filename, and creation time for the stored object identified by the key.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Resolves the storage path for a given key, checking both legacy and current storage directories.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Lists keys with a specified prefix, filtering out hidden files.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Saves data from an InputStream to the storage with associated metadata and returns the generated key.

methods.name: purgeData
methods.description: Deletes the data identified by the key.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if data with the given key exists in storage.

methods.name: newPath
methods.description: Creates a new Path object for a given key, ensuring it is within the storage directory.

methods.name: assertKeyInStorageDir
methods.description: Validates that a given path is within the storage directory.

methods.name: getLegacyStorageDir
methods.description: Returns the legacy storage directory path, used for backward compatibility.
